architecture.summary: The owner turned the habit-hooks comment check off. .habit-hooks/config.toml and .habit-hooks/hook.config.toml disable the smell non-essential-comment ([smells.non-essential-comment] disabled = true). The comment sensor of the typescript plugin gives only this smell, and the smell was advisory (severity suggested), so no enforced check and no exit code changes: a full scan of main exits 0 before and after, with 2,667 comment findings before and none after. The hook configuration keeps its other settings (88 oversized-file findings before and after); nothing in the repository runs it. The policy flag is set: the change removes a check that habit-hooks reported. No production code, test, contract, dependency, composition, build output, or deployment relationship changes: nothing in src/, test/, the runtime images, or the workflows reads these files. The component registry describes the runtime system only; its prose and all 21 views remain accurate and unchanged.
